_readme: Edit this file to change prices, contact numbers and delivery fee. The website and the order system both read it.
_products_note: stand and coaster: basic = small size, plus = large size (stand 10x15 / 15x20 cm, coaster 9x9 / 12x12 cm). extra_price = each add-on (custom design, landing page) on stands and coasters. instapay and vfcash = tap cards (one plan only). Remove a product here to hide it from the store.

home._note: Home page rails. product: card | stand | coaster | instapay | vfcash. plan: basic | plus (stand/coaster: small | large size). design: stand design id (google, instagram, facebook, instapay, vfcash, menu, remotap). Edit best sellers to match real orders.

_delivery_note: delivery_fee = Cairo and Giza. delivery_fee_other = every other governorate in Egypt.
_card_type_note: card_type_price = EGP added to the card price for each type (can be negative). Edit in the admin under Products & prices.
_services_note: Extra services shown on /services. price empty = 'price on request'. Edit in the admin under Extra services.
